question: Should OpenClaw adopt this experiment-gated core lifecycle diagnostics slice, and if so should it land after the MCP ownership slice before the dependent update-planning work?
rationale: The patch is an additive feature rather than a repair of an established behavior, and it makes core Doctor responsible for interpreting a new lifecycle ownership model across an unmerged PR stack.

options.title: Sponsor the staged core experiment
options.body: Approve the ownership-stack order, require the documentation gate correction, and review this diagnostics slice as the read-only core stage before dependent update work.

options.title: Defer the core surface
options.body: Keep the PR open until maintainers decide whether lifecycle ownership diagnostics belong in OpenClaw core rather than an external or later experiment.
